meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 它会以只读方式分析仓库里所有开放的 issue 和 PR，把每一项交给一个后台子任务去调查，并写成带 GitHub 证据链接的报告，存到 /tmp 下的日期文件夹里。它绝不会对 GitHub 做任何修改。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”“triage issues” 等关键词，要求整理 issue 或 PR 时触发，分析该仓库全部开放项目。

say.note: 对当前仓库的全部 issue 和 PR 做只读分析并写报告。
只分析所有开放的 issue。
只分析所有开放的 PR。

howto.what_en: It performs read-only triage of all open issues and PRs in the repo, spawning one background quick subagent per item and writing an evidence-backed report (with GitHub permalinks) to /tmp/{timestamp}/. It never mutates any GitHub state.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage' (or similar triage commands). It then processes every open issue and PR in the repository.

say_en.note: Analyzes all open issues and PRs and writes reports.
